(a) For category A rotorcraft--
  (1) The fuel system must meet the requirements of Sec. 29.903(b); and
  (2) Unless other provisions are made to meet subparagraph (1) of this paragraph, the fuel system must allow fuel to be supplied to each engine through a system independent of those parts of each system supplying fuel to other engines.
(b) Each fuel system for a multiengine category B rotorcraft must meet the requirements of paragraph (a)(2) of this section. However, separate fuel tanks need not be provided for each engine.
